notes: The panel is a generic brand-styled illustration labelled 'ilustração' (BRIEF: site panel screenshots are old UI). Concept print configuracoes-novas-espetacular.png maps to ASSETS slug configuracoes-novas-espetacular.png; the print is about new combat settings (targets after revive, moves after the 2nd creature), not provably about the 05/09/2026 redesign, so it is shown in full (context visible), tagged 'print real de cliente', quoted verbatim, and never captioned as a reaction to the new panel. 'caminho guiado pra quem tá começando' became the label 'estilo guiado' + caption 'pra quem tá começando'. Hook card kept at 5 words. Loop bridge returns to the hook.
